circuit.cp_rule: blocked capacitance counted exactly once; reciprocal theta signs
circuit.energy_boundary: mechanical+piezo+PMIC input port; encrypted internal losses unqualified

firmware.pgood_low_inflight: abort INIT/TX/SLEEP to WAIT if PGOOD<2.5V

geometry.gap_actuation: move rotating driver at fixed stationary tip

initial_energy.mechanical_state_rule: k*q0 = interpolated F(angle=0,q0); qdot=0; equilibrium preload energy counted

mission.cold_start_gate: max(Vout)>=3.2V and >=1 receiver group; result still insufficient_evidence

packet.byte_order: raw bytes in C; cloud can match with two little-endian uint32 IDs

source_trajectory.coordinate_rule: fixed tip at x=.904; driver x=(.904-gap)*cos(a)-.045*sin(a), z=(.904-gap)*sin(a)+.045*cos(a)-.075265
source_trajectory.electrical_input: none at baseline; configurable continuous diagnostic current into Vin

units.firmware_input_conversion: upstream dt milliseconds, current milliamps; adapters convert explicitly

version.numerical_semantics: LTspice waveform fixed point; maxstep 50us; firmware bin minimum 100us; reltol1e-4
